generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A specialized adapter promotes lifecycle state through a direct persistence update and skips temporal side effects that the canonical transition guarantees.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Update status and audit metadata in the adapter while omitting the canonical temporal marker because happy-path tests only inspect final status.

reusable_control.description: Compare canonical and specialized promotion paths with divergent temporal facts and require the same temporal postconditions.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Specialized state promotion must call the canonical transition or a shared helper that implements all required temporal side effects and preserves independent historical facts.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: For every specialized promotion surface, use divergent temporal fields and assert required marker creation, historical immutability and an independent sibling surface.

transfer_cases.evidence: Generic contract test checks prevention rule and reusable control presence.
